episodes.title: Quand on arrive en ville
episodes.summary: Deep in the forest, the body of a young woman is found hanging from a tree. Major Laurène Weiss attempts to solve the mystery while also welcoming an eccentric new prosecutor to Villefranche. Together they investigate, in a town already under pressure from the recently announced closure of the local sawmill and the disappearance of the Mayor's daughter.

episodes.title: À quoi rêvent les loups
episodes.summary: Laurène comes face to face with a wolf which appears to be guarding a newborn baby hidden in a box. She undertakes to find the baby's parents, followed from afar by the mysterious animal. As everything rapidly becomes complicated, memories from her troubled past resurface.

episodes.title: En abyme
episodes.summary: An amateur caver emerges traumatised from a labyrinth of subterranean grottos where he says he lost his friend. Laurène tries to unravel fact from fiction in his witness statement before contemplating a perilous descent. At the same time, Cora thinks that the Mayor's daughter has been kidnapped by a mysterious group of activists who are leaving their marks on the walls of Villefranche.

episodes.title: Nous n'irons plus au bois
episodes.summary: A phone is found with videos showing a group of young people terrified by a macabre discovery in the forest. After the body of one of the young people is found, Laurène and her team investigate, endeavouring to understand what went wrong on their nocturnal spree. At the same time, she tries to assess her complicated relationship with Bertrand, the town's Mayor.

episodes.title: Le Bout de la route
episodes.summary: Everyone is shocked by the attack on Sabine's bar by a band of robbers who came out of nowhere. While the town barricades itself in, Laurène has to find and understand what they were looking for in Villefranche. Meanwhile, Cora and the Arduinna Children follow the mysterious trucks rumbling at night through the forest.

episodes.title: Sombres héros
episodes.summary: A woman suicides on the same day that her husband is awarded a medal of honour. Laurène suspects that this man isn't quite the hero that everyone thinks they know. She tries to discover what dark secrets he's hiding, but he's protected by the Mayor, an old childhood friend.

episodes.title: Le secret derrière la fenêtre
episodes.summary: The father of a child with a mental disability is found dead at his farm. We're concerned for the boy's future at the same time as we seek his father's killer, but Laurène is troubled because the prosecutor Siriani has arrested Bertrand.

episodes.title: La fin n'est que le commencement
episodes.summary: The investigation into the disappearance of the Mayor's daughter advances with the discovery of her body in the middle of a bizarrely staged location. While Bertrand loses control and seeks vengeance, Laurène finally gets close to the invisible enemy that she's been tracking for many years.

episodes.title: Comment nous vivons maintenant (1)
episodes.summary: Laurène cuts her sick leave short to investigate the murder of a quarry worker. In flashbacks to 57 B.C., a Roman expedition takes a harrowing turn.

episodes.title: Comment nous vivons maintenant (2)
episodes.summary: While Teddy Bear combs through the latest victim's Super 8 footage, Laurène returns to the library to research ancient Celtic rituals.

episodes.title: Dans une autre vie
episodes.summary: A bizarre bee attack leads to a grisly discovery at a pond. Laurène takes Jonas into custody to find out what he knows about the figure in the forest.

episodes.title: Coup de lune
episodes.summary: As the full moon sends the town into a frenzy, Hermann grapples with ghosts from his past, and Siriani seizes a chance to inspect the quarry.

episodes.title: La Jeune Fille et le Mort
episodes.summary: Laurène stumbles on a surreal crime scene near a piano in the forest. Cora searches for clues to Roman's fate. Garnier digs up info on Siriani's past.

episodes.title: Sanctuaire
episodes.summary: As Laurène desperately tries to escape the ravine and get help for Teddy Bear, memories of her kidnapping surface. Siriani makes a troubling discovery.

episodes.title: Comme un chien
episodes.summary: With the squad hobbled and the Celtic day of the dead looming, Laurène begs a commander for reinforcements. Dogs lead the way to another body.

episodes.title: L'Ombre et les Proies
episodes.summary: As animal bones pop up around Villefranche, Laurène and Bertrand assemble a team to scour the woods, and the Children of Arduinna prepare their attack.
